modules.title: Complexity & Big-O
modules.tagline: The language interviewers use to compare solutions.
modules.shortDescription: Time and space complexity, amortized analysis, recurrence relations, and how to reason about algorithm cost in an interview setting.

modules.title: Recursion Fundamentals
modules.tagline: Base case, recursive case, and the call-stack mental model.
modules.shortDescription: How to structure recursive solutions, tail recursion, recursion-to-iteration conversion, and the relationship to DFS and backtracking.

modules.title: Arrays & Hashing
modules.tagline: The O(1) lookup lever that unlocks 40% of interview questions.
modules.shortDescription: Array traversal, prefix sums, frequency counting with hash maps, and the two-sum family of problems.

modules.title: Two Pointers
modules.tagline: Shrink the search space without extra memory.
modules.shortDescription: Opposite-end traversal, fast-slow pointers, partition patterns, and when two pointers beat a hash map in space.

modules.title: Sliding Window
modules.tagline: Turn nested loops into a single linear pass.
modules.shortDescription: Fixed and variable-size windows, substring problems, max/min subarray, and the window-invariant technique.

modules.title: Binary Search
modules.tagline: Halve the search space — on data and on the answer.
modules.shortDescription: Classic binary search, rotated arrays, boundary finding, binary search on the answer, and avoiding off-by-one bugs.

modules.title: Stack & Queue
modules.tagline: LIFO and FIFO — and the monotonic trick.
modules.shortDescription: Balanced brackets, expression parsing, monotonic stack, next-greater-element, and queue-based BFS prep.

modules.title: Linked List
modules.shortDescription: Reversal, merge, cycle detection (Floyd's), intersection, and the dummy-node technique.

modules.title: Trees & BST
modules.shortDescription: Traversals (pre/in/post/level-order), BST invariants, LCA, serialization, and balanced tree properties.

modules.title: Heap & Priority Queue
modules.tagline: Top-K problems at their most elegant.
modules.shortDescription: Binary heaps, priority queue APIs in Java and Python, top-K patterns, merge-K sorted, and running-median.

modules.title: Graphs
modules.tagline: BFS, DFS, and everything that builds on them.
modules.shortDescription: Graph representations, BFS, DFS, topological sort, union-find, shortest path, and cycle detection.

modules.title: Backtracking
modules.shortDescription: Permutations, combinations, subsets, N-Queens, Sudoku solver, and constraint propagation.

modules.title: Dynamic Programming
modules.shortDescription: Memoization vs tabulation, 1D and 2D DP, knapsack family, subsequence problems, and interval DP.

modules.title: Greedy Algorithms
modules.tagline: Local choices that produce global optimums.
modules.shortDescription: Interval scheduling, activity selection, Huffman coding, jump game, and proving greedy correctness.

modules.title: Intervals
modules.shortDescription: Interval merging, overlap detection, meeting rooms, and sweep-line technique.

modules.title: Bit Manipulation
modules.shortDescription: XOR patterns, bit masking, counting set bits, power-of-two checks, and subset enumeration via bitmask.

modules.title: Math & Number Theory
modules.shortDescription: GCD/LCM, prime sieves, modular exponentiation, combinatorics basics, and overflow-safe arithmetic.

modules.title: Tries
modules.tagline: Prefix trees for autocomplete and word search.
modules.shortDescription: Trie construction, insertion/search, autocomplete, word-search on grids, and space-optimized variants.
